summary: Fix 10 bugs in the React Todo App: state mutation, missing keys, form handling, filter logic, division by zero, input validation, and localStorage issues.

tasks.title: Fix state mutation in addTodo
tasks.description: The addTodo function directly mutates the state array with todos.push(), which React doesn't detect. Use immutable update instead.
instructions: Read src/App.jsx to find the addTodo function
Replace lines 24-25 (todos.push(newTodo); setTodos(todos)) with:
setTodos(prev => [...prev, newTodo])
This creates a new array instead of mutating the existing one
Also update localStorage.setItem to use the new array

tasks.title: Fix missing unique keys in TodoList
tasks.description: Using array index as key causes incorrect component reuse when items are deleted. Use todo.id instead.
instructions: Read src/TodoList.jsx to find the map function
Change line 28 from key={index} to key={todo.id}
This ensures React can correctly track each component

tasks.title: Fix missing form prevention in TodoForm
tasks.description: The form submit handler doesn't prevent default, causing page reload. Add e.preventDefault().
instructions: Read src/TodoForm.jsx to find the handleSubmit function
Add e.preventDefault() as the first line of the function
This prevents the browser from reloading the page on form submit

tasks.title: Fix incorrect filter logic in App
tasks.description: The active/completed filters are swapped. 'active' shows completed todos and vice versa.
instructions: Read src/App.jsx to find the filteredTodos logic
Swap the conditions on lines 48-49:
Change 'if (filter === 'active') return todo.completed' to 'return !todo.completed'
Change 'if (filter === 'completed') return !todo.completed' to 'return todo.completed'
This ensures active filter shows incomplete todos and completed shows complete ones

tasks.title: Fix division by zero in TodoStats
tasks.description: The percentage calculation divides by zero when there are no todos, showing NaN%.
instructions: Read src/TodoStats.jsx to find the percentage calculation
Add a guard clause: if (total === 0) return 0
Change line 8 to: const percentage = total === 0 ? 0 : Math.round((completed / total) * 100)
This prevents NaN when no todos exist

tasks.title: Add input validation to TodoForm
tasks.description: Empty todos can be added because there's no validation on the input text.
instructions: Read src/TodoForm.jsx to find the handleSubmit function
After the e.preventDefault() line, add validation:
if (!text.trim()) return
This prevents adding empty or whitespace-only todos

tasks.title: Fix clearCompleted to only remove completed todos
tasks.description: The clearCompleted function removes all todos instead of just completed ones.
instructions: Read src/App.jsx to find the clearCompleted function
Replace setTodos([]) with setTodos(todos.filter(t => !t.completed))
This keeps only the non-completed todos
Also update localStorage.setItem to use the filtered array

tasks.title: Add input validation to TodoList edit
tasks.description: The handleSave function doesn't validate empty text when editing todos.
instructions: Read src/TodoList.jsx to find the handleSave function
Add validation before calling onEdit:
if (!editText.trim()) return
This prevents editing todos to empty strings

tasks.title: Fix localStorage dependency array
tasks.description: The useEffect for loading todos doesn't save updates because todos is missing from the dependency array.
instructions: Read src/App.jsx to find the useEffect on line 14
This is tricky - we can't add todos to the dependency array or it creates an infinite loop
Instead, create a separate useEffect that saves to localStorage whenever todos changes:
useEffect(() => { localStorage.setItem('todos', JSON.stringify(todos)) }, [todos])
Remove the localStorage.setItem calls from addTodo, toggleTodo, deleteTodo, editTodo, and clearCompleted
Keep only the setTodos calls in those functions

tasks.title: Fix toggleTodo state mutation
tasks.description: The toggleTodo function mutates state by modifying todo objects directly.
instructions: Read src/App.jsx to find the toggleTodo function
Replace the forEach loop with a map that creates new objects:
const updated = todos.map(todo =>
todo.id === id ? { ...todo, completed: !todo.completed } : todo
setTodos(updated)
This creates new objects instead of mutating existing ones
